name: deck-renderer
body: Deck renderer: assembles the whole-deck reveal.js document — applies theme CSS, reveal.js config (navigationMode passed through from `navigation`), vertical stacks, anchors and notes — over the per-slide documents. Realised by internal/render.RenderDeck, the top-level entry internal/server.Reloader.renderDefault calls. The render tier splits by role: solution.component.renderer executes templates and section instances bottom-up; deck-renderer assembles the resulting deck document.
